text:
Megan T.: FYI opened PR #4998 — adds a small 'networking and KMS edgecases' appendix for Private/VPC installs. Wants a Node.js SDK fallback example for air-gapped installs, and a short cert-rotation sanity check for on-prem HSMs.

Ibrahim S.: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4998. Local link-check flagged one bad anchor in the network guide: /docs/private/network#egress-notes -> 404.

Docs Bot: link-checker: PR #4998 -> broken anchor /docs/private/network#egress-notes. Suggest replacing with /docs/private/network#egress-proxy.

Zoe K.: For NodeJS fallback, propose this tiny example: ```js
// prefer env vars in airgapped sites
process.env.RW_KMS = 'local'
process.env.RW_KMS_PATH = '/var/lib/local-kms/keys'
const rwinf = require('rwinf-sdk')
const client = new rwinf.Client()
// client will read RW_KMS/RW_KMS_PATH from env
``` Keep it minimal and call out non-prod testing.

Ibrahim S.: Nice. Add line about socket permissions: `chown -R redwood:redwood /var/lib/local-kms` and `chmod 750 /var/lib/local-kms`.

Megan T.: HSM cert-rotation sanity check: add commands to verify cert chain and token after rotation: `openssl s_client -connect hsm.example.local:8443 -showcerts` and `pkcs11-tool --list-token-objects --module /usr/lib/hsm/libhsm.so --login` (mention PIN env var caution).

Zoe K.: Also include a quick MTU/NAT note — in some edge infra MTU 1500 -> 1400 required for gRPC streams. Suggest a test: `ping -M do -s 1372 <peer>` and include expected fragmentation behavior.

Ibrahim S.: Add KMS health probe one-liner: `timeout 3 curl -k https://127.0.0.1:8443/healthz || echo 'kms unreachable'` and note `-k` only for internal test certs.

Megan T.: Migration checklist snippet: before migrating KMS certs, snapshot HSM token labels and export mapping: `pkcs11-tool --list-slots --module /usr/lib/hsm/libhsm.so > /tmp/hsm-slots.txt` and back up `/etc/redwood/hsm.conf`. Call out that restoring mapping is critical.

Zoe K.: Rollback snippet for on-prem (systemd safe-restart + cache flush): `rwinf-admin cache flush --prefix=model:` then `sudo systemctl stop redwood-inference; tar -xzf /opt/redwood/releases/v2026.03.tgz -C /opt/redwood; sudo systemctl start redwood-inference`. Note: expect ~60s while KV cache warms.

Ibrahim S.: Docs nit: change "restart the service" -> "perform a graceful restart" in the rollback appendix. Also fix the broken anchor to /docs/private/network#egress-proxy.

Megan T.: I'll push the edits: add Node snippet, cert-rotation checks, MTU ping example, KMS healthcheck, and the anchor fix. Ping here when CI/link-checker runs.

Docs Bot: automated-checks: please wrap inline code in backticks for single-line commands and fenced triple backticks for blocks. link-checker will re-run on push.

Zoe K.: I'll run through the MTU ping on our staging VPC after the PR lands. If green, :shipit:.

Megan T.: Thanks all — will update and tag reviewers. Merge after link-checker and Zoe's MTU thumbs-up. :rocket:
